items.q: Match each urine colour with its listed cause — 1) Green 2) Brown 3) Orange … A) Nitrofurantoin B) Rifampicin, entacapone C) Triamterene (ENaC blocker)
items.exp: Green – triamterene (ENaC blocker); brown – nitrofurantoin; orange – rifampicin, entacapone (COMT inhibitor). (Book p740)

items.q: Pink urine on the appearance table is attributed to:
Urine that darkens on long standing points to which drug combination?
items.exp: Darkening on long standing: Imipenem + cilastatin. (Book p740)

items.q: Which colour-drug pair is NOT as written in the appearance table?
items.exp: Desferrioxamine gives pink urine; green is triamterene (ENaC blocker). (Book p740)
